_description: Equipment list only (HVAC-001, PUMP-001, FAN-001, CHILL-001) — no geometry coordinates. Tests that the pipeline doesn't crash on inputs with no spatial data, stamps all elements it does produce, and never fabricates source filenames.

assertions.name: coverage_100pct
assertions._comment: All non-spatial elements produced must carry Pset_BuiltingProvenance.

assertions.name: model_not_empty
assertions._comment: Pipeline must produce at least one non-spatial element — catches total-crash regressions.

assertions.name: no_fabricated_sources
assertions._comment: Key regression gate: if extract starts fabricating baselines from missing source data, a non-sentinel source file will appear here.
